## [Three-lead benchmark and ECG-AIM deep dive](three_lead_ecgaim_benchmark.html)

U-Net, cNVAE, MSVAE and ECG-AIM with observed leads **I, II and V2**, clinical biomarkers, and the completed LUDB/RDB oracle and blinded evaluations.

## [One-lead spatial, wavelet and SSL development](one_lead_wavelet_dashboard.html)

Source lead I versus II, A0–E1 controls, the live 120-run queue, and RDB-supervised six-boundary training.

These are separate scientific tracks. Existing LUDB/RDB leaderboards are three-lead ECG-AIM results and are not attributed to unfinished one-lead models.
